authContext.note: Shell redirects to /admin/sign-in when useStaff() is null (components/admin/Shell.tsx:~64). The code does not gate this screen by role; roles are those whose access list (lib/admin/d-fixtures.ts:113-121) includes this path.

special.note: ?q= and ?state= in the address prefill the filters; Wishes without state in nav clears the filter. Search box refetches on every keystroke (key is q|state).
